acceptance_criteria.criterion: When `project.project_summary` is present and non-empty, the `.plan-synopsis` block renders the escaped plain text (not parsed as Markdown).
When `project.project_summary` is absent or empty, the `.plan-synopsis` block falls back to `extractSynopsis()` + `marked.parse()`.
The "View full plan →" link is present in both rendering paths.
The toggle behavior from WP-001 applies correctly to both the `project_summary` and `extractSynopsis()` rendering paths.
For projects with `synthesis_generated === true` and a non-null `outcome_summary`, an `.outcome-synopsis` block is rendered below the synthesis link row.
The `.outcome-synopsis` block uses a distinct accent color differentiating it from `.plan-synopsis`.
For projects without `synthesis_generated` or with a null `outcome_summary`, no `.outcome-synopsis` block is rendered.

summary: Updated synopsis rendering IIFE in project-detail.js to prefer project.project_summary (escaped plain text via escapeHtml()) when present, falling back to extractSynopsis()+marked.parse() when absent. Both paths produce identical HTML structure with id=plan-synopsis so the WP-001 toggle IIFE works unchanged for both rendering paths.

Added outcome-synopsis IIFE after the synthesis link row that renders a .outcome-synopsis block when synthesis_generated===true and outcome_summary is non-null/non-empty, using escapeHtml() for XSS-safe plain-text rendering.

Added .outcome-synopsis and .outcome-synopsis__content CSS rules to styles.css using --color-complete (green, #16a34a) as the left-border accent to distinguish it visually from .plan-synopsis which uses --color-ready (blue). Added white-space:pre-wrap to preserve any embedded newlines in the outcome_summary text.
All code is ES5-compatible: var declarations, no arrow functions, no template literals.

comments.note: project-detail.js: The outcome-synopsis block has no toggle/expand mechanism since outcome_summary values tend to be concise (1-3 sentences). If long outcomes become common, a future WP could add the same .plan-synopsis toggle pattern here.

styles.css: The .outcome-synopsis__content uses white-space:pre-wrap to preserve embedded newlines from the stored outcome_summary string. This differs from .plan-synopsis__content which renders HTML from marked.parse(). The difference is intentional but should be noted in the stylesheet comment.

Edge case: empty string for project_summary is correctly treated as falsy (falls through to extractSynopsis fallback). Same for outcome_summary. Both edge cases handled correctly.

summary: Reviewed project-detail.js (synopsis IIFE rewrite, outcome-synopsis IIFE) and styles.css (.outcome-synopsis rules). All 8 ACs met. Code is clean, ES5-compliant, XSS-safe, and consistent with the file's existing IIFE patterns. No blocking issues. Two low-priority observations recorded; no Fix-Forward edits required.

comments.note: The outcome-synopsis block has no pre-rendered hidden container (unlike synthesis-link-row which pre-renders as `<div id='synthesis-link-row' style='display:none'>` for poll-driven reveal). If synthesis completes while the user is viewing a live project detail page, the outcome-synopsis will not appear dynamically — a page refresh is required. This is outside WP-003 scope and is a narrow race condition, but a future WP could add a `_patchOutcomeSynopsis()` patch function alongside the pre-rendered empty container to close the gap.

The fallback synopsis path uses `marked.parse(synopsis)` which returns block-level HTML (typically `

` tags), while the project_summary path wraps with an explicit `

`. Both render correctly inside `.plan-synopsis__content` due to the `p { margin: 0 0 0.4em }` rule, but the structural difference between the two paths is subtle. A code comment above the IIFE noting this intentional asymmetry would help future contributors avoid confusion when debugging render output differences between the two paths.
No issues — code is clean and consistent.

WP-003 passes review. No rework needed. Two low-priority observations recorded (no-toggle gap for outcome-synopsis on live polling, and an asymmetry note between the two synopsis rendering paths). For Documentation: the WP-003 scope adds two new rendering behaviors to the project detail page — (1) project_summary preferred over extractSynopsis when set, and (2) outcome_summary displayed in a green-accented card below the synthesis link row. Both behaviors use escapeHtml() for XSS-safe plain-text rendering. No API surface changes in this WP (that was WP-002); this is purely GUI-layer.
